profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
Hello!  I am currently a Software Engineer at Meta doing full-stack web development.  I am passionate about deeply understanding users' needs and building solutions to solve them.

I earned a dual Bachelor’s and Master's Degree in Computer Science and Engineering from the Schreyer Honors College and College of Engineering at The Pennsylvania State University.  My thesis focused on applied reinforcement learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Engineer for Small Business Card

- Contributed to and maintained Spring Boot applications, enabling real time transaction level
underwriting for small business charge card product

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Android Engineer for CreditWise

- Enabled push-button production releases with a new deployment pipeline, integrating quality
control, automated testing, code scanning, and enterprise release management into one process,
eliminating a several day manual process
- Overhauled portions of the application’s user interface with new design system, emphasizing re-
useable components and styles
- Designed a microservice and REST API to store and access user goal information
- Supported run-the-engine operations of our free-to-use Android application with over 1,000,000
monthly active users

positions.title: Distinguished Undergraduate Researcher and Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
- Benchmarked and investigated the Elastic stack (Logstash, Elasticsearch, Kibana)
- Examined and applied reinforcement learning algorithms to autonomous underwater vehicle
navigation (copy of Master’s Thesis available upon request)

company.name: The Applied Research Laboratory at Penn State University

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern - CreditWise iOS
positions.description:
- Rearchitected, refactored, and unit tested significant portions of the CreditWise iOS application
- Utilized MVVM architecture and reactive programming paradigms to modernize the application and
increase testability

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Paid undergraduate researcher in the department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology.

Completed  an independent research project  in conjunction with the NASA Freshman Undergraduate Research Program (FURP).

Developed a recombinant DNA strain of E. coli. to overexpress the gene for a modified and immobilizable urocanase enzyme and optimized its growth for larger scale production.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Led and managed 3 teams of 5-7 software developers, introducing agile/scrum development
principles for continuous delivery systems
- Contributed to the development of enterprise-scale management tools
- Architected new software that reduced spectator wait time from 10.0 to 1.5 hours
- Served on the executive committee and collaborated with other student leaders to ensure the
success and sustainability of our multimillion-dollar, 16,500-student-strong philanthropy
- Used Python on top of Django to build a building management and floor access software for a
building that seats over 15,000 people

Developed building management software using Python and Django framework to manage capacity and ensure the safety and satisfaction of all event guests.

Collaborated with other student leaders to ensure the success and sustainability of the world's largest student-run philanthropy.
